description: List the calendars in the user's connected Google account(s): name, id, whether it's the primary, and the user's access role. Use it to find a named calendar ('Family', 'Content schedule') before reading its events with get_calendar_events(calendar_id=…). If it says the account needs reconnecting, link the user to https://youspot.com/user/integrations/gmail.

account.description: Email address of one connected Google account. Omit to list calendars for all connected accounts.

name: list_google_calendars
title: List calendars
